offering_description.value: Provides investment management products and services through affiliated boutique managers. Serves individual investors via retail separate accounts, mutual funds and ETFs, and institutional clients via separate accounts, plus structured products such as collateralized loan obligations. Earns fees on assets managed.

primary_products.value: mutual funds; exchange-traded funds; closed-end funds; collateralized loan obligations; variable insurance funds

primary_services.value: investment management; retail separate account management; institutional separate account management; fund administration and distribution

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual investors via advisors, mutual funds, ETFs and retail managed accounts; B2B: institutions, pension plans, endowments, insurers, wealth managers and financial advisors

end_markets.value: asset management; wealth management; institutional investing; insurance

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: investment management fees based on assets under management; service fees: fund administration and distribution fees; other: performance fees and CLO collateral management fees
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; service fees; other

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: manages client assets through affiliated managers, sold to retail and institutional investors

geography_served.value: global: Primarily US clients, with institutional and international clients in Europe, Asia and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: multi-boutique equity, fixed income, multi-asset and alternative investment strategies

distribution_channels.value: partners / resellers: financial advisors, broker-dealers, wirehouses and registered investment advisors; direct sales: institutional sales team to pensions, endowments and consultants

regulatory_exposure.value: high: registered investment advisers and funds regulated by SEC under Investment Advisers Act and Investment Company Act, FINRA
